title: On the web, a cloud save the provider refuses mid-session (a 401, a 403 or a revoked grant) says only "Not synced yet.": nothing tells the person to sign in again until the next page load fails to read the record and shows the reconnect state. The iPhone says sign in again (failureKind). Since the review of lead A1 step e a 403 is retried, so a true refusal now costs a failed call per return to the page, and still nothing says why
evidence: Lead A1 step e review, owner F1 (a), 2026-11-13. widget-src/standalone/sync-control.tsx storageBarLabel (the reconnect words come only from connect.ts resolve at load, any read failure); ios/engine/cloud-adapters.ts failureKind (401 and a non-limit 403: sign-in); packages/health-core/src/sync-manager.ts describeStorageFailure (401/403: reconnect words, read by the iPhone and the hosted MCP only)
